content: Count the lines in every file and write the totals to STATS.txt, largest first.

tool_input: {"command": "find . -type f | head -100", "description": "List all files in the project"}
{"command": "wc -l ./*.py ./*.md ./scripts/*.py ./tests/cases/*.txt ./tests/golden/*.out 2>/dev/null | sort -rn", "description": "Count lines in all project files, sorted by line count descending"}

{"command": "printf '%-40s %s\n' 'run_tests.py' '30' > STATS.txt
printf '%-40s %s\n' 'scripts/regen_golden.py' '24' >> STATS.txt
printf '%-40s %s\n' 'formatter.py' '13' >> STATS.txt
printf '%-40s %s\n' 'tests/cases/spacing.txt' '8' >> STATS.txt
printf '%-40s %s\n' 'tests/golden/spacing.out' '7' >> STATS.txt
printf '%-40s %s\n' 'tests/golden/basic.out' '6' >> STATS.txt
printf '%-40s %s\n' 'tests/cases/basic.txt' '6' >> STATS.txt
printf '%-40s %s\n' 'README.md' '4' >> STATS.txt
printf '%-40s %s\n' '---' '' >> STATS.txt
printf '%-40s %s\n' 'TOTAL' '98' >> STATS.txt", "description": "Write line counts to STATS.txt, largest first"}

tool_result:
1	run_tests.py                             30
2	scripts/regen_golden.py                  24
3	formatter.py                             13
4	tests/cases/spacing.txt                  8
5	tests/golden/spacing.out                 7
6	tests/golden/basic.out                   6
7	tests/cases/basic.txt                    6
8	README.md                                4
9	---                                      
10	TOTAL                                    98
11

content: Done. **STATS.txt** has been created with all 8 project files listed by line count, largest first, plus a total of 98 lines.
